Series Narrative

Synthetic narrative: employees calibrate imaginary widgets & gauges.

DESCRIPTIONS OF LEVELS OF WORK

9901
Level I: Widget Calibrator I

Entry level synthetic work under general supervision.

A(n) Widget Calibrator I typically -
  1. calibrates synthetic widgets using gauges;
  2. records calibration readings in a ledger;
  3. performs other related duties as assigned.

9902
Level II: Widget Calibrator II

Advanced synthetic work under direction.

A(n) Widget Calibrator II typically -
  1. supervises widget calibrators & trains staff;
  2. performs work related to the lower level in this series;
  3. audits calibration ledgers.
